map.在浏览器中用 MediaRecorder 录音，常见约束为采样率 44100Hz: Recording in the browser with MediaRecorder, the common constraints are 44100Hz or 48000Hz sample rate, mono or stereo. With a WebM/Opus container a bitrate around 128kbps is enough for speech; for lossless material export WAV (16bit/44.1kHz mono is about 5MB per minute). Before recording, use the live level meter to confirm the peak stays below 0dBFS to avoid clipping.
map.为什么有时录出来有杂音或爆音？: Why does the recording sometimes have noise or clicks?
map.多为输入增益过高导致削波，或环境回授产生啸叫。可先降低麦克风增益、离声源 15~: Usually input gain is too high and causes clipping, or the environment feeds back and produces howling. Lower the microphone gain, stay 15~30cm from the sound source and record in a quiet room; local browser processing never uploads audio, so privacy stays under your control.
